# Azgaar terrain subset

Source: https://github.com/Azgaar/Fantasy-Map-Generator
Pinned revision: `7940ee81c675befe784f047f92f212aaa031e38b`.
Azgaar sources are MIT licensed, Copyright 2017-2024 Max Haniyeu. See LICENSE.

Adapted files:
- `heightmap.js`: `src/generators/heightmap-generator.ts`, template generation only.
- `templates.js`: `src/data/heightmap-templates.ts`, all 14 procedural recipes unchanged.
- `grid.js`: generation, lookup, and placement subset of `src/generators/grid-generator.ts`.
- `voronoi.js`: `src/generators/voronoi.ts`.
- `helpers.js`: required numeric/probability helpers from `src/utils`, plus minimal
  local implementations of the three D3 operations used by this subset.

Modifications: stripped TypeScript, removed browser/global registration and
image loading, made graph/config explicit, injected local seeded randomness,
and bounded strait/ridge random walks to prevent a stuck preview. Upstream
height operations and template recipes are retained. The grid and terrain each
start with Alea(seed), matching the upstream reset order without replacing the
application's Math.random. MapMaker resamples these heights to its coastline
renderer; this is not the complete upstream application or pixel-identical
upstream rendering. No cultures, politics, rivers, settlements, or artwork from
the wider application are generated by this subset.

Dependencies vendored as ESM by replacing their UMD wrappers:
- Alea 1.0.1: https://unpkg.com/alea@1.0.1/alea.js (alea.LICENSE).
- Delaunator 5.0.1: https://unpkg.com/delaunator@5.0.1/delaunator.js
  (delaunator.LICENSE). Its distributed bundle includes robust-predicates code;
  see robust-predicates.LICENSE.

`scripts/vendor-azgaar.mjs` reproduces the conversions using Node 24 from a local
folder containing the reviewed upstream TS files, dependency bundles, and
licenses. It performs no downloads. Normal app use needs no build or install.
